expression: For every CCW hull edge, retain route-segment parameters t satisfying cross(edge, p(t)-edgeStart) >= -tolerance
preconditions: Piecewise-linear route with strictly increasing stations
Accepted evidence-bounded surface with a CCW convex hull
Common projected CRS and metre units
decisionLogic: Clip each route segment against all convex-hull half-planes.
Evaluate contact elevations at exact clipped endpoints.
Merge adjacent supported pieces sharing a route vertex.
Discard zero-length tangencies because they do not support an area interval.
uncertainty: Floating-point half-plane tolerance is numerical only; it is not geological uncertainty
exclusions: No support interval from a single tangent point
validationMethod: Oblique exact crossing, bent-route re-entry, outside, tangent and invalid-station tests
reopenCondition: Non-convex evidence domains, curved route primitives or geodesic clipping is required
